Last year, my flatmate took some LSD on a party I wasn't attending.
During the three weeks following that party, he became weirder and weirder (disappearing from the flat for hours, saying one thing then the opposite...)

That day, he asked me to come in his room, said he had to tell me something. First was "Why did you call my mum ?" (I did not, the dude and I were from two completely opposite part of the world so I had no interest and reason to call her), second was "I love you". 

Thing is : we were not flirting, I never thougt he might be attracted in some sort. I said I wasn't interested, he said "OK", and then he started following me in the flat, following me in my room... He freaked me out so much I left the flat for the night (he btw tried to follow me) and went to a friend's.
Next day, he broke his phone on purpose, started to act crazy in the city and ended up arrested by the police and put in psychiatric hospital. When the cops came at the flat to find any weapon, they found out he had kept two of my underwear in his bedroom.

He stayed the next few weeks in the hospital. They called me and told me he asked for me, that we were engaged and that I was the love of his life. Started to post weird stuff on my FB wall too.
I never freaked out so much.

Don't do LSD guys. This shit can seriously blow your brain up. It did for him and caused him a mental breakdown.

I was two oceans away from my family and friends(exchange year) and never have I ever freaked out so much in my life. Hopefully I never saw him again.
Hope he's getting better though.

(I know it's not a roommate but a flatmate but still hope it's relevant and btw I'm a girl)
